validated_results.reason: Dehydroepiandrosterone appears only incidentally as an enzymatic substrate in the description of HSD3B1 function, and the study actually examines CYP17A1/HSD3B1 polymorphisms and serum testosterone rather than a DHEA nutritional exposure.
